why: A's slim, low beige track-arm sofa, adequately sized jute rug, walnut round table and paper lantern create the calm, sparse japandi look the client described, missing only the ceramic pot (the money tree comes in a plastic nursery pot). B's bulky 76 cm-high chaise sectional isn't the low sofa requested and overwhelms the undersized 133×195 rug, and its areca palm in a plastic pot reads more tropical than japandi.
